name: Elemental Surge (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Elemental

Benefit(s): Once per day as a free action you rapidly expand your form and then reform, instantly injuring those around you. You inflict 1d6 points of damage for every two Hit Dice you possess to everything within a 10-foot radius. If your elemental subtype is fire, this damage is fire damage, otherwise it is bludgeoning damage.
